_comment_purpose: This file is a REFERENCE EXAMPLE, not a deployed settings file.
Copy relevant sections to your project's .claude/settings.json.
Never copy this file as-is. Review each section for your project needs.
Do not commit secrets. Use environment variables for sensitive values.

permissions._comment: Adjust these rules to match your project's actual commands.
_comment_deny: These are prefix patterns, not regex: Bash(rm -rf *) does not match
rm -fr or rm -r -f. The real gate is hooks/scripts/pre-tool-safety.sh,
which parses the command; see hooks/tests/test-pre-tool-safety.sh.

hooks._comment: See hooks/README.md for documentation. Adjust paths to match your project.

PreToolUse._comment: Warn before destructive bash commands. Blocks execution if script exits 2.

Stop._comment: Log session end for audit trail. Non-blocking (exit 0 always).

env._comment: Environment variables for the Claude Code session. No secrets here.
